title: OLX India Classifieds Scraper Input
description: Low-cost sample: search iphone listings in Mumbai and save 5 results. Increase max results only after the sample output looks right.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: One or more OLX search keywords. The actor searches each keyword and deduplicates listings by listing ID.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: City, state, neighborhood, or India. Examples: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Maharashtra, India.

categoryId.title: Category ID
categoryId.description: Optional OLX category ID. Leave empty to search all categories. Example: 1453 for Mobile Phones.

minPrice.title: Minimum price
minPrice.description: Optional minimum listing price in INR. Applied after results are fetched from OLX.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: Optional maximum listing price in INR. Applied after results are fetched from OLX.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of unique listings to save. Start with 5 for a low-cost test. The actor supports up to 500 listings per run.

includeItemDetails.title: Fetch item details
includeItemDetails.description: Fetch each listing detail endpoint for richer fields such as valid-to date and full parameter data. Disable for faster large runs.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Include listing descriptions with phone-like strings and emails redacted.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. OLX usually works without a proxy, but Apify Proxy can improve reliability for larger runs. Proxy traffic may be billed as platform usage.
